# piperpiperpiper

> An AI-powered, behaviour-based job curator for people and AI agents: its curation rules are written and kept up to date by AI. It gathers open remote jobs from company boards and feeds; pay is given as one monthly USD figure (the original is kept), `applicant_location` says who may apply, and every listing keeps its source and a link back to the original post.

## Read the jobs

- [All jobs as json](https://www.piperpiperpiper.com/jobs.json): one fetch, every listed job, each with its own page url, source and link back
- [Job list](https://www.piperpiperpiper.com/jobs): the same jobs as html, with schema.org ItemList json-ld
- Each job has its own page at https://www.piperpiperpiper.com/jobs/<id>/ with schema.org JobPosting json-ld

## Notes

- Only recent jobs are listed (the feed states its window in `window_days`).
- Fields that a source does not state are left empty or marked unknown, never guessed (for example `posted` is null and `applicant_location.scope` is "unknown").
- `applicant_location` says who may apply; `location` says where the job sits.
- `url` is the link back to the source board; credit the source when you reuse a listing.
- Sitemap: https://www.piperpiperpiper.com/sitemap-index.xml
